lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、栄養の、本気で、絶対、吸収、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: You really handled nutrition absorption thoroughly in your paper, Sakura. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, observational delivery with steady eye contact. Unhurried pace. Genuine praise landing soft but clear—not performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。化学工場の、本気で、絶対、原料、絶対、調達、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I looked into raw material sourcing for chemical processing quite deeply. I really appreciate your feedback.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Slight pause before answering, weighing her words. Earnest without flatness. Voice settles at the end, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 考古学の、本気で、絶対、発掘、絶対、現場、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your archaeology section was thorough too. The excavation site research—I was really taken by the depth of it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower pace. Warm recognition layered underneath. A teacher noticing something that mattered, not just grading.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。気候変動による、本気で、絶対、天候、絶対、不順、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I spent a lot of time on how climate irregularity affects fieldwork conditions. Thank you for recognizing that effort.
lines.style: Steady, direct. Pride underneath, but expressed through specificity rather than tone. Clear-eyed about her own work. Honest gratitude.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 深海の、本気で、絶対、未知、絶対、生物、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your deep-sea research was remarkable. The work on unknown organisms—you really went deep there.
lines.style: Genuine delight, careful not to overstate. Light energy. Noticing details that matter. The warmth of seeing a student push themselves.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。希少種の、本気で、絶対、絶滅、絶対、危機、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to explore extinction risk in rare species properly. That research meant a lot to me.
lines.style: Sincere, unguarded for a moment. Personal investment showing through. Steady voice. Not seeking more praise, just saying something true.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 通貨の、本気で、絶対、換算、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your currency analysis was excellent. The way you integrated those conversions—very rigorous work.
lines.style: Clear, professional recognition. Slight nod of approval in the voice. Acknowledging technical skill without overshadowing it. Composed warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。離島の、本気で、絶対、沿岸、絶対、生態、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I focused on coastal ecosystems in isolated regions—how isolation shapes biodiversity. I'm grateful you saw what I was trying to do.
lines.style: Quiet conviction about her own work. Calm, not rushed. Vulnerable underneath—needing to be understood, not just praised. Soft landing at the end.
